'''Chapter 454''' is titled "Humming".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: "Deadly Combat."

[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Franky]] are fifty-three rounds deep into a boxing match, with no end in sight; all around the ring, a crowd of animal spectators (including [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]]) cheer on with [[wikipedia:Cornerman|cornermen]] [[Sanji]] and [[Usopp]]. High above, [[Nico Robin|Robin]] dutifully keeps score.

==Short Summary==
The chapter starts off with [[Lola (Zombie)|Lola]] chasing [[Nami]]. Nami then exclaims that she is in fact a man, which calms the zombie down. After making friends with it, [[Absalom]] appears but Lola starts chasing him so Nami can escape. Back at the [[Thousand Sunny]], [[Perona]] is raiding the ship when [[Hildon]] appears to summon her to [[Gecko Moria|Moria]]. At the bridge, [[Franky]] and [[Nico Robin|Robin]] battle [[Tararan]], but are ultimately trapped in his web. [[Brook]] then makes an entrance and defeats Tararan in one slash.

==Long Summary==
[[Lola (Zombie)|Lola]] keeps chasing [[Nami]], with [[Usopp]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] trying to stop her. They fail, and Lola is ready to attack Nami. When she tries to kill her, Nami shouts that she is in fact a man. Lola believes her, and Nami asks her to be friends. When [[Absalom]] appears again, Lola runs towards him and Nami and the others find a chance to leave.

In [[Thousand Sunny]], [[Perona]] is stealing the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]]' treasures. [[Hildon]] appears and tells Perona that [[Gecko Moria|Moria]] is calling for a meeting. She goes to her room, just to find Absalom and [[Kumashi]] there already. Nami, Usopp and Chopper are hiding inside [[Kumashi]] just to participate in this meeting.

Outside, [[Franky]] and [[Nico Robin|Robin]] witness [[Brook]] falling from the sky and lands badly on the ground. [[Tararan]] uses his web to reach them, but Robin and Franky trap him inside his webs while Franky deals some damage to him too. They think they defeated him, but he recovers and his spiders trap Robin and Franky.

Out of nowhere [[Brook]] appears in front of them, finishing off Tararan with a deadly slash.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*The scene in the cover appears in the 12th One Piece Opening ''[[Kaze o Sagashite]]".''
*Nami befriends [[Lola (Zombie)|Lola]].
*The Mysterious Four are called to a meeting with Moria, with Nami, Usopp and Chopper hijacking [[Kumashi]] to attend alongside Perona.
*Brook reveals his abilities as a swordsman, defeating [[Tararan]].
